acts.desc: Ira talks to a man in his 70s who’s about to travel across the country to tell a woman he loves how he really feels, despite some very real signs that doing so might be a bad idea.
acts.label: Prologue
Act One
acts.desc: Jesse had been waiting his whole life to fall in love—and then he started getting these letters from the perfect woman, Pamala. She seemed vulnerable. In need of protection. A classic beauty. He was totally devoted. They corresponded for years. And when something happens that really should change how he feels about her— he just can’t give it up. NPR’s social science correspondent Shankar Vedantam reports the story. He hosts the podcast Hidden Brain.
acts.credits: By Shankar Vedantam, Act Extra, Correspondence From the Col Angels
acts.title: Jesse’s Girl

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Comedian Elsa Waithe tells about going to Time’s Square to take part in the Black Lives Matter protests, and winding up with a huge crush on her arresting officer.
acts.title: My Love Is Blue

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Julia Lillis talks to Ira about the huge, romantic move she made after a break up, and how it was both crazy and worth doing.

songs.t: The Heart Wants What It Wants

acts.title: Unbreak My Heart
